description: Lookalikes of one company: the companies that share its industry segments, the technologies its job postings name, its headquarters country and a size band near it - the starting point for a market map, a competitor scan, a prospect list built from a best customer, or alternatives to a supplier. Each row is a company (as in search_companies) plus similarity: a score, the segments and technologies it shares with the target, whether its headquarters is in the same country and how far its size band is. Narrow to one country with country. Staffing agencies and job boards are left out. Name the company by Alion id, domain or name; an ambiguous name is reported in warnings. detail=compact rows cost the least, and connected assistants (Claude, ChatGPT) get a daily allowance of compact reads free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs

limit.description: How many lookalikes to return (1-25, default 10).
